framework: Manuel Academy Ready for Life — High School Competency Progression, Grades 9-12
authority_statement: This is NOT a state, national, or third-party standards framework, and no claim of alignment to one is made. Ready for Life is a Manuel Academy subject with no external standards body. Every competency below was written for this repository. It extends the existing published progression, whose Grade 5, 7, and 8 courses in curriculum-content/manuel-academy/1.0.0 carry the literal standards string 'Manuel Academy RFL Grade <n> progression' — an equally local declaration. No external standard was cited, implied, inferred, or invented to lend this framework borrowed authority.

safety_charter: No shame. Difficulty with a life skill is never framed as a character flaw, and no lesson compares learners.

No unsafe unsupervised real-world task. Any task involving heat, sharp tools, chemicals, medication, electricity, heights, ladders, power tools, driving, water, money movement, or contact with unfamiliar adults is guardian-supervised or is simulated.
Guardian sign-off is required wherever a real-world task is claimed as evidence, and a click alone can never certify one.
No credential collection. No password, account number, government identifier, card number, or real balance is ever requested, displayed, stored, or entered anywhere in this lane.
No forced private disclosure. Autobiographical or household disclosure is never required; a fictional or analytical alternative is always offered and is never scored lower.
Accessibility is not an accommodation afterthought. No task requires a photo of the learner, a voice recording, a public performance, or a specific response modality.

certification_rule.statement: A click cannot certify a real-world adult-supervised task.
certification_rule.implementation: Every lesson whose evidence depends on a real-world action carries requires_guardian_signoff = true and an adult_attestation object naming the observing adult role, what the adult actually observed, and the date. A learner-side completion toggle records only that the learner reports finishing; it never satisfies the attestation, and the Study Engine treats an unattested real-world task as incomplete evidence rather than as mastery.

evidence_rule: Practice generation never directly awards mastery. Mastery requires accurate independent evidence plus explanation on at least two separate occasions, at least one of them transferred to a situation the learner has not rehearsed. Guardian-confirmed real-world performance counts as one occasion only when attested.
privacy_rule: Parent-visible evidence remains minimized: lesson target, completion state, evidence type, guardian attestation where required, and the next instructional step. Raw reflections, raw responses, recordings, photographs, household detail, and any diagnosis-like language are not surfaced.
limits: This framework confers no credential, credit, licence, certification of competence, or statement that a learner is safe to perform any task unsupervised.

Nothing here is medical, legal, financial, employment, or immigration advice. Where a topic touches those domains the lesson teaches how to find and evaluate a qualified human source, and explicitly declines to individualize.

Local law varies. Driving, working papers, curfew, age of majority, tenancy, and identification rules differ by jurisdiction; lessons direct the learner to verify locally rather than asserting a rule.
